name: @basancorp/nocobase-master-agent-kit
displayName: NocoBase & BasanCorp Enterprise Master Agent Kit (Version-Adaptive)
description: Comprehensive skill suite for NocoBase with multi-version adaptive intelligence (v2.2.x LTS, v2.4-alpha Rsbuild, and v3.0-alpha Vibe-Coding). Covers data modeling, UI building, enterprise multi-level approval flow, webhook security, external data sources, tenant printing, and plugin development.
author: BASANCORP Enterprise Solutions

skills.name: nocobase-data-modeling
skills.description: Create and manage NocoBase collections, fields, relations (o2m, m2o, m2m), indexes, and server-side Joi validation rules.

skills.name: nocobase-ui-builder
skills.description: Author Modern UI pages, blocks, tables, forms, details, calendar, kanban, charts, and jsBlock KPI metric cards.

skills.name: nocobase-portal-manage
skills.description: Dispatcher for NocoBase UI authoring: resolves active portals and routes between No-code Portal (/v/) and AI Portal (/x/).

skills.name: nocobase-approval-flow
skills.description: Enterprise multi-level approval flow engine: org-tree hierarchy, digital touch signatures, 1-click batchAct, recall, urge, resubmit, auto code sequences, physical state writeback, 3-generation compatibility (v1/v2/v3), and 8 enterprise security/concurrency guardrails.

skills.name: basancorp-workflow-webhook
skills.description: Fintech-grade Webhook Gateway: HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, constant-time comparison, X-Timestamp anti-replay protection, 4-tier log cleaner, and 1-click replay.

skills.name: basancorp-data-source-external
skills.description: External database connector for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB with enforced read-only guard, connection pool tuning, and 1-click schema drift refresh.

skills.name: basancorp-tenant-print
skills.description: Dual-engine document print & export: direct thermal POS bill printing (80mm/58mm) and Word DOCX/PDF template rendering with Vietnamese currency in words and approval signatures.

skills.name: basancorp-multi-space
skills.description: Multi-Tenant & Multi-Workspace enterprise manager: Schema-per-Tenant isolation, hybrid plugin tiering, ghost login, and tenant clean view.

skills.name: nocobase-workflow-manage
skills.description: Manage backend automation workflows, triggers (table events, cron, webhook), sequential node chains, version-safe revisions, and execution diagnosis.

skills.name: nocobase-acl-manage
skills.description: Manage roles, action permissions, data scopes, user-role membership, and state-based record locks.

skills.name: nocobase-env-manage
skills.description: Manage NocoBase application environments via nb CLI: installation, runtime start/stop, database connections, and version upgrades.

skills.name: nocobase-revision
skills.description: Save completed app-building milestones as restorable snapshots via nb revision create with safe rollback capability.

skills.name: nocobase-publish-manage
skills.description: Cross-environment release operations: backup, restore, and schema migration between staging and production instances.

skills.name: nocobase-dsl-reconciler
skills.description: Declarative YAML-DSL building path for whole NocoBase systems committed to git and synchronized via cli push.

skills.name: nocobase-ai-builder
skills.description: Build, customize, and verify full source-code React/TypeScript applications in NocoBase AI Portals (/x/).

skills.name: nocobase-plugin-development
skills.description: Multi-version NocoBase plugin engineering (v2.2 LTS dual-client, v2.4 Rsbuild, v3 Headless/Refine), Zero-Trust ACL, state machine concurrency locking, safe document printing, and v1 AMD stub compatibility.

skills.name: nocobase-plugin-manage
skills.description: Inspect, enable, disable, and configure NocoBase plugins via CLI.

skills.name: nocobase-ai-employee
skills.description: AI employee lifecycle management: model restrictions, prompt configuration, and knowledge-base bindings.

skills.name: nocobase-ai-knowledge-base-manager
skills.description: Manage vector databases, local/external knowledge bases, documents, and semantic retrieval tests.

skills.name: nocobase-ai-manager
skills.description: Manage AI LLM providers, model bindings, and API keys securely.

skills.name: nocobase-data-analysis
skills.description: Query and analyze business data across collections via MCP protocols.

skills.name: nocobase-file-manager
skills.description: Manage file storage engines (local, S3, OSS), file collections, and attachment metadata.

skills.name: nocobase-notification-manage
skills.description: Configure in-app messaging, email SMTP channels, and workflow notification nodes.

skills.name: nocobase-prototype-repro
skills.description: Faithfully reproduce HTML or design mockups into native NocoBase applications.

skills.name: nocobase-utils
skills.description: Reference utilities covering filter conditions, evaluator formula engines (math.js, formula.js), and expression syntax.
